primary_source.eq15_recovery: The ordinary web text extraction omitted the display. An independent direct request to the same primary HTML recovered the MathML alttext: F_i is the degree sum, while its component is sqrt(n)*a_i,p times the entrywise pairing of Xi_i,p and psi_i tensor-powered p times.

formula_audit.parameters: K=2^(74*(h+1)), P=2^(64*(h+1)), S_i=sum_{j=0}^{h-i} K^j. The Lean finite sum includes both endpoints. Natural subtraction is legitimate because i:Fin(h+1) supplies i<=h.
formula_audit.degree_range: Even p, 4<=p and p<=P is precisely membership in {4,6,...,P}; P is even and at least 4 for every h:Nat. No odd degree, p=0 or p=2 is admitted.
formula_audit.amplitude: a=1/(p^4*S_i^2*sqrt((h-i+1)*log(2*P*S_i))). All powers, the factor 2, the logarithm argument and the square-root scope agree. Nat-to-real casts preserve the intended parameters; the inner 2-power is real-valued in the formula.
formula_audit.scaling: The definition has exterior sqrt(n)*a, not n*a or sqrt(n*a). Thus the candidate variance is n*a^2, not its square root.
formula_audit.denominator_and_boundaries: There is no division-by-zero fallback in the intended parameter range: S_i>=1 from j=0, h-i+1>=1, p>=4 and 2*P*S_i>1, so the denominator is positive. These facts remain derived obligations, not extra assumptions. At i=h, S_i=1 and only the last direction remains; h=0 is also coherent.

coordinate_dimension_audit.reindexing: The local u j denotes the source direction u_(i+j), for 0<=j<=h-i. Earlier directions do not occur in this component, so omitting them loses no dependency.
coordinate_dimension_audit.slot_type: Let B=Sigma j:Fin(h-i+1), Fin(K^j). Its elements name a trailing block and one repetition within that block. The full slot type T=Fin(p) x B names p copies of the entire source tensor. No symmetrization or quotient is taken.
coordinate_dimension_audit.slot_cardinality: card(B)=sum_j K^j=S_i and card(T)=p*S_i. In particular, the j=0 block has one repetition, not K repetitions, and the j=h-i block has K^(h-i) repetitions.
coordinate_dimension_audit.coordinate_type: C=T -> Fin(n) chooses a basis coordinate independently in every tensor factor; card(C)=n^(p*S_i). Therefore EuclideanSpace R C has exactly the source coefficient-block dimension. Its elements are tensor-coordinate arrays, not functions equipped with the sup norm.
coordinate_dimension_audit.feature_entry: For c:C the product over s:T of u(s.2.1)(c(s)) is the ordered tensor-power entry. The first slot coordinate repeats the full psi p times, while the sigma repetition coordinate repeats each direction K^j times. Although these two labels are unused by the entry projection, they are essential multiplicities in the finite product.
coordinate_dimension_audit.pairing: Summing xi(c) times that entry over every c:C is the real entrywise Euclidean pairing. Commutativity of real multiplication reconciles Mathlib's inner-product argument order; no complex conjugation or factorial normalization is missing.
coordinate_dimension_audit.unit_norm_reason: For fixed unit directions, the squared coordinate norm expands as sum_c product_s (u(s.2.1)(c(s)))^2 = product_s sum_k (u(s.2.1)(k))^2 = 1. This mathematical audit identifies the finite-product-of-sums bridge; it does not certify a Lean proof of that bridge.
coordinate_dimension_audit.domain_extension: The definition evaluates the same finite polynomial for arbitrary vectors. This is an explicitly disclosed polynomial extension, not a replacement source sphere domain or an invented if/default branch. The law theorem retains every unit-norm condition and claims nothing about unit feature norm off that domain.
coordinate_dimension_audit.formal_status: Slot/coordinate cardinality identities, the tensor norm identity and the scalar-law proof are not established Lean edges by this review.

seven_slot_semantic_audit.objects: One finite-dimensional standard Gaussian coefficient block, its explicit repeated tensor feature, and a real scalar component; no arbitrary source-law witness substitutes for the construction.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.domains: Real Euclidean coefficient/direction spaces; unit directions in the law; the actual block Borel probability measure; positive integer n and bounded natural i,p.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.quantifiers: For every permitted deterministic n,h,i,p,u with hu, the resulting function of xi has the specified pushforward law. This is pointwise in fixed directions, not a field joint law or a result for xi-dependent/adaptive directions.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.assumptions: Only expanded dimension/index/degree/unit-direction inputs occur. Joint independence across distinct (i,p) is neither assumed nor necessary for this one-block marginal claim.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.conclusion: HasLaw f mu P expands to AEMeasurable f P and P.map f=mu. Both fields are conclusions. gaussianReal 0 v uses v as variance. Here v=(n*a^2).toNNReal, whose real coercion is n*a^2 because that expression is nonnegative; no negative variance is silently truncated.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.scopes_and_senses: stdGaussian on the concrete Euclidean coefficient carrier has identity covariance and independent standard coordinates in an orthonormal basis. It is the unconditioned coefficient law, not the admissibility-conditioned measure, the base spatial Gaussian with variance 2/3, or the full joint coefficient law mu_n.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.constant_dependencies: K and P depend only on h; S also on i; a additionally on p. The exterior sqrt(n) is separate. There are no unspecified asymptotic or regularity constants.
seven_slot_semantic_audit.declared_generalizations: The source initially fixes sufficiently large n and h=floor((log n)^(1/3)/32). The isolated identity needs neither restriction: its finite-coordinate law is meaningful for all positive n and all natural h. Acceptance preserves that explicit generalization; it must not be described later as proving arbitrary parameters yield a valid hard family. The off-sphere polynomial extension is also disclosed, while the theorem remains sphere-restricted.
